findings.description: F-005: the object_diagram (build_chapter_20.py:2566-2576) was captioned «Реальное состояние работающей игры в конкретный момент времени — то, что на самом деле хранится в памяти между кадрами», but two of its five values were unreachable in the shipped bouncing_ball.py. (a) schet must equal otskokov * OCHKOV_ZA_OTSKOK, since _na_otskok() increments both and _reset_myach() zeroes both -- otskokov=7 forces schet=70, not 140. (b) |v| is invariant at NACHALNAYA_SKOROST=220.0 (set in _reset_myach, sign-flipped on bounce, magnitude-preserved by tolknut_k_tochke), but hypot(180.0, -95.0) = 203.531. Because the caption asserted these were the real in-memory values, this was a false factual claim, and it undercut the very invariant notebook 20-33 asserts.
findings.resolution: Fixed in scripts/build_chapter_20.py by replacing the invented values with a genuinely reachable snapshot captured from the shipped project: seeded the RNG, stepped BouncingBallGame until otskokov == 7 plus 25 more frames, and read the real attributes — x,y = 38.7, 328.8; vx,vy = -182.5, -122.9; otskokov = 7; schet = 70. Both invariants now hold (schet == otskokov*10, and hypot(vx,vy) == 220.0 == NACHALNAYA_SKOROST). The caption now also names the two invariants explicitly so the reader can check them. Verified after rebuild: «180.0, -95.0» returns 0 files and «38.7, 328.8» returns 1.

findings.description: F-006: the alt text at build_chapter_20.py:2613 stated «вверху слева текст «Счёт: 90 Отскоков: 9»», but the committed site/assets/img/chapter-20/output/bouncing-ball-pro-hud.png reads «Счёт: 10   Отскоков: 1» (confirmed by opening the file). Since alt text is the accessible substitute for the image, a screen-reader user was told a different game state than sighted readers see. Root cause is reproducibility: _reset_myach() uses random.uniform(0, 2*math.pi) and scene_myach_pro() never seeds random.
findings.resolution: Fixed in scripts/build_chapter_20.py: the alt text now reads «вверху слева текст «Счёт: 10   Отскоков: 1»», matching the committed PNG exactly, and the caption spells out the rule (one bounce = ten points). Re-seeding the screenshot generator would be the deeper fix but scripts/generate_chapter_20_outputs.py is outside this batch's permitted file set; the notebook side of the same root cause is fixed under F-021. Verified after rebuild: «Счёт: 90» returns 0 files and «Счёт: 10» returns 1.

findings.description: S-008: the comparison-table row «Клик мышью — необязательный лёгкий толчок мячу» (build_chapter_20.py:2587) understated the behaviour -- tolknut_k_tochke() normalises the direction to the click and re-applies the unchanged speed magnitude, i.e. it redirects the ball rather than nudging it.
findings.resolution: Fixed in scripts/build_chapter_20.py: the row now reads «Клик мышью — необязательный разворот мяча в сторону клика». Verified present once in the rebuilt 20-33-finalnyj-proekt-myach-pro.html.
